name: File Paths - Authorized - Internal Network Share [starts with]
description: Intent: Authorized internal network-share paths — populate with UNC path prefixes of every corporate file server and SMB share (e.g., \\corp-fs01.acme.local\Shared, \\dfs.acme.com\Departments). Drives the Authorized Internal direction on D8010 / D8011 / M8010 and is paired with the External share list to define the unauthorized surface on D8000 / M8000 / W8000 / B8000. Top priority to populate — foundation for internal file-share governance. Exclusions: do not add external partner shares; do not add unmanaged or ad-hoc file servers; do not add paths lacking documented access control.
